info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Direction Product Strategy-spec
info.description: The Business Direction Product Strategy API allows organizations to define and manage their product strategy within the banking sector. This API facilitates the creation of strategic directions for products, enhancing decision-making and aligning offerings with market demands. Typical consumers include product managers and strategists seeking to develop comprehensive product roadmaps. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their strategic initiatives and ensure their product portfolios are well-aligned with overall business objectives.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new product strategy within the business direction framework. It requires relevant data to define the strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business goals.

requestBody.description: The request body containing information to create or update the product strategy. This should include relevant details about the business direction and associated strategies for product development.
